description.value: Cask & Barrel is a specialty liquor store in West Kelowna that has been operating since 2015, billing itself as the Okanagan's premier destination for local and international alcoholic beverages. The store is particularly well-regarded for its curated craft beer program — with a focus on bringing lower mainland BC breweries to the interior — alongside a thoughtful wine selection guided by a certified ISG Sommelier on staff. Touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan can stock up on local wines, BC craft beers, craft ciders, and spirits.

address.value: 1135 Stevens Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 2S8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at caskbarrel.ca fully corroborates the OSM record: same address (109-1135 Stevens Rd, West Kelowna V1Z 2S8), same phone (778-755-6116), and the store is clearly active with a copyright date of 2025 and an events calendar. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null. The business has been operating since 2015 and self-describes as 'The Okanagan's Premier Liquor Store.'
concerns: Website navigation/account area displays 'filler@godaddy.com' as a signed-in user — this is a GoDaddy website-builder template artifact, not a real account; the business contact email (info@caskbarrel.ca) is correctly listed in the contact section.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active liquor store with a confirmed web presence, operating since 2015, publicly accessible to any touring cyclist wanting to purchase local wines, craft beers, or spirits.
